findings.label: Scaffold not its own git repo / no commit
findings.detail: No .git exists under rpa-ai-workshop; the only repository on the path is at C:/Users/HMPrajwa, which reports no commits yet. Non-blocking for the scaffold content, but initialize a dedicated repo (or confirm the intended repo boundary) and make a clean initial commit before pushing, so the .gitignore secret-ignore and sample-PNG carve-out rules take effect. Repo boundary and first push are a downstream workflow step.
